product_one_liner.value: Verifiable provides an API-first provider-network management platform that automates credentialing and verification workflows for healthcare provider and payer organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer do not show a pricing link; the site directs visitors to contact or book a demo.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is predominantly company, product, and healthcare-operations content; it includes one engineering-stack article, not a technical blog with at least two engineering-authored build posts.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation includes a detailed reference, getting-started material, release notes, and multiple API sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job-board inventory lists Customer Success Manager, Solutions Engineer, and Enterprise Customer Success Manager; none has an AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The subprocessor page associates OpenAI with credentialing data processing and Anthropic’s Claude with code generation, evaluation, testing, and workflow assistance.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page says Verifiable is audited annually against the SOC 2 standard.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was the July 2023 Series B, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists three openings, all in customer success or solutions engineering, with no SDR, BDR, or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest product launch listed in the press archive is CredAgent on February 26, 2026, before the six-month window; recent blog entries are not launch announcements.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company press archive’s latest named executive appointment is Brett Dooies as Head of Product on July 22, 2025, before the specified 12-month window; the current leadership listings show no subsequent C-level or VP appointment, and no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A business-development job listing names both systems for sales outreach and activity tracking.
